department: Civil and Environmental Engineering PhD program

deadline.quote: Civil and Environmental Engineering - PhD 14-Week URI Grad Application January 1

gre_general.value: The department does not require the GRE.

entry_route.value: Applicants should have a master's degree in civil or environmental engineering or a related field; exceptional bachelor's holders are also considered.
